title: Paperless Underway — synthetic offline training log
description: Self-contained offline form with transactional local storage and explicitly simulated peer reconciliation/routing. No transport or operational endpoint.

components.label: Training log workspace
components.description: Labeled synthetic form, draft/save status, validation and responsive review workspace.

components.label: Validation and revision graph
components.description: Deterministic validation, immutable revisions, all-head conflict resolution and review gates. Shared classic-script core embedded in HTML and exported for Node.

components.label: Local transaction store
components.description: IndexedDB stores revision graph, pending queue, draft, review and audit atomically before save acknowledgement. Unencrypted local prototype storage.

components.label: Conflict and human review
components.description: Competing values including deletion, explicit choice, saved-content review and deliberate approval before simulated routing.

components.label: Simulated second replica and routing
components.description: Labeled local fixtures, replay/order exercises and simulated receipt. No network transport or authenticated recipient.

components.label: Action history and export
components.description: Persist fictional actor decisions and revision references; inspect and export synthetic history with source reference.
